name: Pyhä Ski Resort
description: Discover Pyhä, a family-owned ski resort in the heart of Finnish Lapland, where Arctic wilderness meets effortless adventure. Ski uncrowded slopes, experience easily accessible freeride terrain beside Pyhä-Luosto National Park, and chase the Northern Lights. Authentic, exotic and refreshingly peaceful, Pyhä offers a true Lapland experience just 1,5 hours from Rovaniemi.
